title: MutexaGPT-guided cold-adapted amylase variants
summary: The MutexaGPT multi-agent large language model system translated a cold-adaptation design request into molecular simulations and linker-variant proposals for bidomain amylase. The authors report experimentally validated variants with 1.7-fold and 3.7-fold activity enhancement at 0 °C. The preprint appeared on 19 June 2026; the peer-reviewed journal version followed on 10 September 2026.
ai_technology: Multi-agent large language model system coordinating high-throughput molecular dynamics simulations and mutation design

evidence.tested: The primary article reports two MutexaGPT-guided bidomain amylase linker variants with experimentally measured 1.7-fold and 3.7-fold activity enhancement at 0 °C. The Methods define relative activity using the 0 °C to 45 °C activity ratio.
evidence.unknown: The experimental result is specific to the tested bidomain amylase and variants; broader enzyme-family transfer and independent reproduction are not established.
evidence.ai_role: LLM agents clarify the design request, translate it into computational plans and mutation patterns, and explain simulation outputs. High-throughput molecular dynamics metrics guide the proposed variants; experimental assays test their activity.

source_review.scope: Primary Research Square v1 full-text indexed content and metadata; primary Nature Computational Science indexed article text, including abstract, Methods, experimental result, date and affiliation block.
